name: usage-relay
description: Watches Claude usage and relays work to a DeepSeek session with a written handoff, then back.

five_hour_threshold.title: 5-hour switch threshold (%)
five_hour_threshold.description: When the 5-hour Claude window reaches this percentage, the session writes a handoff and opens a DeepSeek session.

resume_below.title: Return to Claude below (%)
resume_below.description: A DeepSeek session returns to Claude once the 5-hour window has reset and usage is at or below this percentage.

seven_day_threshold.title: 7-day tool-block threshold (%)
seven_day_threshold.description: When the 7-day window reaches this percentage, tool calls are blocked and the person is notified; nothing switches.

poll_seconds.title: Poll period (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often the session asks the usage endpoint for the current 5-hour and 7-day percentages.

handoff_file.title: Handoff file name
handoff_file.description: The file the outgoing model writes in the project root, and the incoming model reads.

claude_model.title: Claude model for the return trip
claude_model.description: The model string passed to claude when a DeepSeek session hands work back.

deepseek_model.title: DeepSeek model for the outbound trip
deepseek_model.description: The model string passed to claude when a Claude session hands work to DeepSeek.

terminal.title: Terminal program
terminal.description: The executable used to open the successor session. `wt` is Windows Terminal, `preview` is Windows Terminal Preview, or give a full path.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns the guard off without uninstalling the plugin.
